content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for JMI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: http://jmi.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 17-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for JMI Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the JMI Guest Faculty recruitment is 17th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned department before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Guest Faculty at JMI?
faq.answer: Jamia Millia Islamia has announced a total of 6 vacancies for the post of Guest Faculty across various departments. This includes 4 posts in the Department of Commerce & Business Studies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for JMI Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with at least 55% marks in the relevant subject, along with NET/SLET/SET qualification or a Ph.D. as per UGC regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for JMI Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 300/-. This fee needs to be submitted along with the application form.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Guest Faculty positions will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for JMI Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q7. Which departments are recruiting Guest Faculty at JMI?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for Guest Faculty positions in the Department of Commerce & Business Studies, Computer Science (Centre for Interdisciplinary Research in Basic Sciences), and Department of Art History & Art Appreciation.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for JMI Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a screening of applications followed by an interview. Candidates are advised to prepare thoroughly for both stages.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form for JMI Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Jamia Millia Islamia, which is http://jmi.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation mentioned for JMI Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age limits or relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official advertisement for any specific age-related information.
